disposition: Endpoint forwarding is source-grounded. The retained longest witnesses contain conservative parameter-output caller detours; no runtime mutation or route feasibility is claimed.
owner: shared dataflow query engine: parameter output effects and longest-witness selection

evidence.staticTest: DartFrontendTests: expose read-only parameter output detours without mixing separate calls
evidence.modelScope: A fixture-only exact-name read-only summary removes the caller detour while preserving forwarding and separate-call isolation. No whole-library purity summary is shipped.

limitations: All three corpus queries recorded call-depth omissions in both modes.
The engine returns the longest witness per endpoint pair, not all alternative routes.
A method parameter source aggregates invocations; the path is not a trace for a particular runtime invocation.

modelFiles.async:
# Completer.completeError stores the error and stack trace in the completer.
# It does not copy either argument into the other and has no return value.
# Load these method names as regular expressions; declaration offsets may vary.
"dart:async/future[.]dart\x23[0-9]+:METHOD:completeError" 0 -> 0 1 -> 1 2 -> 2 1 -> 0 2 -> 0
modelFiles.worker_manager:
# Executor.execute stores the task and priority and returns its cancelable result.
# The task's values do not change the priority argument. This does not model scheduling.
# Tested against worker_manager 7.2.6; load the method name as a regular expression.
"package:worker_manager/src/scheduling/executor[.]dart\x23[0-9]+:METHOD:execute" 0 -> 0 1 -> 1 2 -> 2 1 -> 0 2 -> 0 1 -> -1
modelFiles.iterable:
# Dart SDK 3.9.2: lib/core/iterable.dart and lib/internal/iterable.dart.
# Explicit element values with pure predicates/transforms and statically known callbacks.
# Selection, lazy execution timing and callback side effects are outside this contract.
"dart:core/iterable[.]dart\x23[0-9]+:METHOD:where" 0 -> 0 1 -> 1 0 -> -1
"dart:core/iterable[.]dart\x23[0-9]+:METHOD:map" 0 -> 0 1 -> 1 1 -> -1
"dart:core/iterable[.]dart\x23[0-9]+:METHOD:join" 0 -> 0 1 -> 1 0 -> -1 1 -> -1
modelFiles.bytes:
# Dart SDK 3.9.2 byte-content contract for Uint8List allocation and standard List.setRange.
# Length/range inputs select size and positions; they are not copied element values.
# Keep the constructor offset exact: other dart:typed_data unnamed constructors include SIMD values.
"dart:typed_data\x2336552:CONSTRUCTOR:new" 1 -> 1
"dart:core/list[.]dart\x2329446:METHOD:setRange" 0 -> 0 1 -> 1 2 -> 2 3 -> 3 4 -> 4 3 -> 0
